title: How Much to Charge for Mobile Dog Grooming

facts.fact: The vendor states that its built-to-order grooming trailers start at $13,100.
facts.quote: Our built-to-order grooming trailers start at $13,100, and our [dog grooming trailer cost guide]

facts.fact: The vendor's store hours are Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 4 PM.
facts.quote: We are open Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 4 PM.

facts.fact: The article states that mobile groomers usually do fewer dogs per day than a busy salon because of drive time, setup and one-on-one handling.
facts.quote: Mobile groomers usually do fewer dogs per day than a busy salon because of drive time, setup and one-on-one handling.

facts.fact: The article's pricing method defines cost per groom as fixed monthly costs divided by grooms per month plus variable cost per groom.
facts.quote: Cost per groom = (fixed monthly costs ÷ grooms per month) + variable cost per groom

facts.fact: The article's example of price tiering states that if a doodle takes twice as long as a small terrier, it should cost noticeably more.
facts.quote: If a doodle takes twice as long as a small terrier, it should cost noticeably more.

facts.fact: The article was published on November 7, 2026.
